upload.title: Your next opportunity starts here
upload.description: Upload your CV and we’ll help fill in your profile. You’ll review everything before sharing it with recruiters.
upload.dropDescription: Or choose a file from your device.
upload.formats: PDF, JPG or PNG, max 5 MB
upload.consent: I agree to have my CV read by Google Gemini (free tier), which may use it to improve Google’s models, and my profile stored on this platform. Once I approve it, companies registered for the fair can see my full profile, including my contact details. I can delete it at any time from My profile.
upload.privacy: Read the privacy notice (opens in a new tab)
upload.wait: Please keep this page open while your CV uploads.
upload.requirements: Choose an opportunity, select a valid CV and give your consent to continue.
upload.reassurance: Nothing is shown to recruiters before you approve your profile. Your original CV is deleted after processing.

errors.wrongType: This file type isn’t supported. Choose a PDF, JPG or PNG file.
errors.tooBig: Your CV is too large. Choose a file no larger than 5 MB.
errors.emptyFile: This file is empty. Choose another CV.
errors.multipleFiles: Please choose just one CV at a time.
errors.noChoice: Choose PFE, Internship or Job to continue.
errors.noConsent: Your consent is required before we can process your CV.
errors.dailyLimit: You’ve reached today’s upload limit. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired or you don’t have access. Please sign in again before uploading.
errors.unavailable: CV uploads are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.network: The upload couldn’t finish. Check your connection and try again. If it was already received, check your profile before retrying.
errors.failed: We couldn’t upload your CV. Please try again.

placeholder.candidate: Candidate space — sign-up, upload and review go here (S1-26 → S1-32)
placeholder.company: Company space — CVs, search and QR scan go here (Sprint 2)
placeholder.admin: Admin dashboard — companies and statistics go here (Sprint 2)
